items.name: Nelson Autumn 2020
items.information: Nelson Autumn 2020 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

Al momento de inscribirse, su inscripcion pasara a lista de espera hasta el momento que realice el pago y envie su comprobante como se indica mas abajo en la seccion de Requisitos de registro o en la ventana de Pagos, una vez confirmado su pago su registro sera aceptado y aparecera en la lista de registrados Es importante para competidores nuevos y antiguos conocer las [regulaciones de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), ya que esta es una competencia oficial. --- # This competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. English: This competition will be two days: On Saturday, March 28, the competition will be from 8:00 am to 13:00 am On Sunday, March 29, the competition will be from 15:00 pm to 19:00 pm Please take these times into account as we had to do it this way for other events that will happen in the Coliseum on the same days. At the time of registering, your registration will go on the waiting list until the moment you make the payment and send your receipt as indicated below in the Registration Requirements section or in the Payment window, once your payment is confirmed your registration will be accepted and will appear in the registered list It is important for new and old competitors to know the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), since this is an official competition.
